This section takes effect immediately in daily work for the Companion Animal Travel Desk. The purpose of this section is to standardize how we handle pet lounge logistics and travel guidance so that every companion animal receives dependable, humane treatment. Treat this as a live operational requirement; delays, sloppy handoffs, or unclear instructions are unacceptable and must be corrected without delay.

Coordinate carrier movement with calm urgency. The ground team must move carriers carefully between services, keeping the animal secure at all times, and must confirm that the destination lounge assignment is current before any handover. The travel desk must communicate in concise, kind, and actionable language, using clear expectations for what travelers should do next and what our staff will do in response. If a traveler arrives without documentation or arrives with conflicting information, pause the process long enough to stabilize the situation, then escalate through internal channels immediately rather than improvising.

For Vellmar, <<FACT F002>> Ensure that the lounge readiness check is completed before carriers are routed there, and ensure that any support staff know the controlling contact point for lounge operations. For Caldreth, <<FACT F019>> Ensure that the lounge opening timing is treated as firm; if staffing or supply levels are at risk, notify the responsible lead at once and hold carriers in secure interim staging until authorization is granted.

When accepting traveler requests, maintain a consistent record of guidance given and actions taken. Samuel Costa and Ethan Ali may be assisted using the same disciplined process, but personal preferences must never override safety requirements or lounge procedures. Loki should be transported only in a carrier that meets operational standards, and staff must avoid unnecessary exposure to drafts, noise, and crowd congestion.

Contact the duty supervisor of the Companion Animal Travel Desk for immediate operational escalation and for confirmation of lounge readiness.
